textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerScript
textTemplates.text:
{!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName}, please note that since this is a permanent move, you are required to provide a proof of residence at any one of our branches so that your profile can be updated.

You can use the following documents as a valid proof of residence:

- Rental Agreement or Lease Agreement (valid for 12 months)

- Utility Bills (water, electricity or phone bill not older than 3 months)

- Retail store account (Not older than 3 months)

- Bank Statement from another financial services provider (Not older than 3 months)

You will also be required to produce your original green barcoded ID or Smart ID card at a branch upon updating your address
